$note: Music rotation (random, design language v1.4 §8). /script picks a track when it creates an episode (npm run music:assign -- <nnn>): uniformly at random among the roster, never the previous episode's track. The pick is written to the episode's music.track, so renders are reproducible. Both parts of a two-part episode share one track. Edit 'roster' to add or remove tracks (each must exist in assets/music/library.json).
